hook.en: A single treaty signed on Pangkor Island in 1874 changed how Malay states were ruled for the next 80 years. What did the Sultan agree to?
hook.bm: Satu perjanjian yang ditandatangani di Pulau Pangkor pada 1874 mengubah cara negeri-negeri Melayu diperintah selama 80 tahun berikutnya. Apakah yang dipersetujui oleh Sultan?

bigIdeas.en: Tin wealth, unrest and rivalry with other Western powers led Britain to intervene in the Malay states.
bigIdeas.bm: Kekayaan bijih timah, kekacauan dan persaingan dengan kuasa Barat lain mendorong British campur tangan di negeri-negeri Melayu.

bigIdeas.en: Under the Pangkor Treaty (1874), Perak accepted a British Resident.
bigIdeas.bm: Melalui Perjanjian Pangkor (1874), Perak menerima seorang Residen British.

bigIdeas.en: The Resident's advice had to be followed in all matters except Islam and Malay custom — real power moved to the British.
bigIdeas.bm: Nasihat Residen mesti diikuti dalam semua perkara kecuali agama Islam dan adat Melayu — kuasa sebenar berpindah kepada British.

definition.en: Getting involved in the affairs of another state.
definition.bm: Terlibat dalam hal ehwal negeri lain.

definition.en: British officer whose advice the Sultan had to follow.
definition.bm: Pegawai British yang nasihatnya mesti diikuti oleh Sultan.

definition.en: Indirect British rule through Residents in the Malay states.
definition.bm: Pemerintahan British secara tidak langsung melalui Residen di negeri-negeri Melayu.

definition.en: Fighting between Chinese secret societies over tin mines in Perak.
definition.bm: Pergaduhan antara kongsi gelap Cina kerana lombong bijih timah di Perak.

question.en: Explain the main term of the Pangkor Treaty 1874 and its effect.
question.bm: Jelaskan syarat utama Perjanjian Pangkor 1874 dan kesannya.

steps.en: Term: the Sultan of Perak accepted a British Resident whose advice must be followed except on Islam and Malay custom.
steps.bm: Syarat: Sultan Perak menerima Residen British yang nasihatnya mesti diikuti kecuali dalam hal agama Islam dan adat Melayu.

steps.en: Effect: the Resident controlled taxes, administration and law, so the Sultan and chiefs lost real power.
steps.bm: Kesan: Residen menguasai cukai, pentadbiran dan undang-undang, jadi Sultan dan pembesar kehilangan kuasa sebenar.

answer.en: This loss of power led to resistance, such as at Pasir Salak in 1875.
answer.bm: Kehilangan kuasa ini membawa kepada penentangan, seperti di Pasir Salak pada 1875.
